Definition: conjunction, i.e. society; mostly adverb or preposition (with prepositional prefix), near, beside, along with
BiblicalUsage: 1) juxtaposition; 1a) used only as a prep; 1a1) close by, side by side with, alongside of, parallel with; 1a2) agreeing with, corresponding to, exactly as, close beside; 1a3) correspondingly to
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
